clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Nefarian's severed head is brought before the Horde. After Thrall confirms the black dragon's death, he sends the victor to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength to show the trophy to all.

Nefarian's head reaches Orgrimmar after the black dragon is slain atop Blackwing Lair. Warchief Thrall confirms that Deathwing's son has fallen, then sends the victor to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength. There, the remains are prepared for public display, a warning to enemies and a rallying cry for the true Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Choose your reward so that I may mount the head of the beast for all to see.
